title: Utility Line Protection Plans Rate Card Footnote: Lawn Backfill Amounts on Emergency Requests
content:
# Rate Card Footnote: Lawn Backfill Amounts on Emergency Requests

Footnote to the lawn restoration rate card, Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

Lawn backfill addition: an emergency request on which a temporary repair has been authorized adds the second-backfill lawn addition, because the emergency hole is backfilled once before the permanent dig; an emergency request with no temporary repair authorized on it adds the single-backfill lawn addition; every other request adds no lawn backfill addition. The lawn backfill addition is added to the lawn restoration figure as a flat dollar amount.

## Amounts

| Urgency on the request | Temporary repair authorized on the same request | Lawn backfill addition |
|---|---|---|
| emergency | yes | $60.00 (second backfill) |
| emergency | no | $30.00 (single backfill) |
| routine | either | none |

## Hypothetical examples

- Emergency sewer lateral request with a temporary repair authorized on it: $60.00 is added.
- Emergency request without a temporary repair on it: $30.00 is added.
- Routine request: nothing is added.
